dedupe_keys.name: aneel electricity interruptions on brazilian distribution networks event records 2017 onward

description: This ANEEL data set records all electricity interruptions on the distribution networks of Brazil; interruptions in areas served by public service permit holders (cooperatives) are not included. The fields are defined in a PDF data dictionary. Files are annual, one per year from 2017 to 2026, most with Parquet copies; the resource list was updated in August 2026 and the data set metadata on 4 September 2026. Coverage is Brazilian distribution networks outside cooperative areas. Files are free to download through the portal and its CKAN API under the Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: annual files are large, causes and field meanings must be taken from the dictionary, and cooperative areas are missing. Simulation uses are event-level outage and restoration statistics for storm and failure studies and calibration of distribution reliability models. Related records: data-aneel-dec-fec-continuity-indicators-brazil gives the aggregated DEC and FEC indicators, and data-sinalize-brazil-transformer-outages-climate covers transmission transformer outages.
